text:
kim: FYI PR #4502 updated the /v1/generate examples to include an "attachments" field as an object with named keys. The runtime and OpenAPI actually expect "attachments" to be an array. Preview site shows the Java snippet failing validation. Can someone take this? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4502

angelo: Thanks for flagging. That was an oversight when we copied an internal example. I can fix the markdown and openapi example. We should also update the Java and .NET snippets since their clients map attachments differently.

rebecca: Also check the request param ordering in the example: the docs show headers before body which is confusing in the curl example. Small thing but while we're here let's make the curl example canonical (method, url, headers, body).

docs-bot: docs-lint: openapi/generate.yaml example mismatch: property 'attachments' is defined as array in schema (items: Attachment) but example provided an object (line 92). SDK generation failed for java-client. CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/4502/checks

kim: Angelo take ownership. Please add a 1-line migration callout: "Previously: attachments object. Now: attachments array of {name, content_type, url}." And add a changelog entry under docs/changes/4502.md.

angelo: Will do. Draft curl example I'm pushing:

```
# curl example
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-gen-1",
  "input": "Please summarize attachments",
  "attachments": [
    {"name": "notes.pdf", "content_type": "application/pdf", "url": "https://example.com/notes.pdf"},
    {"name": "image.png", "content_type": "image/png", "url": "https://example.com/img.png"}
  ]
}
```

And Java snippet change:

```
GenerateRequest req = GenerateRequest.builder()
    .model("rwd-gen-1")
    .input("Please summarize attachments")
    .attachments(Arrays.asList(
        new Attachment("notes.pdf", "application/pdf", "https://example.com/notes.pdf"),
        new Attachment("image.png", "image/png", "https://example.com/img.png")
    ))
    .build();
GenerateResponse resp = client.generate(req);
```

rebecca: Nice. Make sure openapi/generate.yaml examples section matches exactly so the SDK generator picks it up. I'll run the local generator after you push. Also I added a tiny test to docs/tests/examples_validate.rb to assert attachments is an array.

docs-bot: reminder: update docs/reference/generate.md and the openapi example in the same commit to avoid flapping in CI.

angelo: Pushed branch docs/generate-attachments-array-fix. Updated both files, added migration callout and changelog. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4510/files

rebecca: Running generator now. One small nit: the markdown used a soft line break inside the example description which made the preview render oddly; I fixed that in a follow-up commit.

docs-bot: CI for PR 4510: example validation passed, java-client snippets generated successfully.

kim: LGTM, thanks. Merging. Will watch #support for any downstream reports from SDK users.

angelo: Merged. Also added a short note in the engineering weekly to call out internal vs public example format differences so this doesn't recur.
